clues: This city spreads along the Apies River, west into the low foothills of the Magaliesberg mountains. It sits in the north east of its land.
This city sits high, yet its sheltered valley traps heat and keeps it warm. Rain comes most in summer, while winters stay dry, with rare sharp frost.
A trek leader founded this city in 1855 on the banks of the Apies River. He chose the spot to be the new capital of his republic.
Thousands of jacaranda trees line the streets and parks of this city. Its own people call it Jacaranda City for them.
The top branch of rule for South Africa sits in this city. So do the embassies of all other lands.
